document_contents_source_snapshot_object.name: document_contents_source_snapshot_object_check
document_contents_source_snapshot_object.value:
jsonb_typeof("document_contents"."source_snapshot") = 'object'
          and "document_contents"."source_snapshot" ?& array[
            'initiativeId', 'source', 'sourceDocId', 'url', 'docType', 'uploadedAt', 'modifiedAt'
          ]
          and jsonb_typeof("document_contents"."source_snapshot" -> 'initiativeId') in ('number', 'null')
          and jsonb_typeof("document_contents"."source_snapshot" -> 'source') = 'string'
          and jsonb_typeof("document_contents"."source_snapshot" -> 'sourceDocId') in ('string', 'null')
          and jsonb_typeof("document_contents"."source_snapshot" -> 'url') in ('string', 'null')
          and jsonb_typeof("document_contents"."source_snapshot" -> 'docType') in ('string', 'null')
          and jsonb_typeof("document_contents"."source_snapshot" -> 'uploadedAt') in ('string', 'null')
          and jsonb_typeof("document_contents"."source_snapshot" -> 'modifiedAt') in ('string', 'null')

initiative_proponents_nonempty_check.name: initiative_proponents_nonempty_check
initiative_proponents_nonempty_check.value:
length(trim("initiative_proponents"."initiative_source")) > 0
          and length(trim("initiative_proponents"."person_namespace")) > 0
          and length(trim("initiative_proponents"."published_name")) > 0
          and ("initiative_proponents"."person_source_id" is null or length(trim("initiative_proponents"."person_source_id")) > 0)

initiative_proponents_resolution_check.name: initiative_proponents_resolution_check
initiative_proponents_resolution_check.value:
("initiative_proponents"."match_basis" = 'unresolved' and "initiative_proponents"."legislator_id" is null)
          or ("initiative_proponents"."match_basis" <> 'unresolved' and "initiative_proponents"."legislator_id" is not null)

initiatives_no_inferred_values_check.name: initiatives_no_inferred_values_check
initiatives_no_inferred_values_check.value:
"initiatives"."category" is null
          and "initiatives"."category_confidence" is null
          and "initiatives"."risk_level" is null
          and "initiatives"."approval_probability" is null
          and "initiatives"."approval_score" is null
          and "initiatives"."needs_review" = false
          and "initiatives"."published" = false

regulations_no_inferred_values_check.name: regulations_no_inferred_values_check
regulations_no_inferred_values_check.value: "regulations"."intervention_level" is null and "regulations"."category" is null and "regulations"."needs_review" = false

score_inputs_no_inferred_values_check.name: score_inputs_no_inferred_values_check
score_inputs_no_inferred_values_check.value:
"score_inputs"."party" is null
          and "score_inputs"."sponsor_record" is null
          and "score_inputs"."executive_support" is null
          and "score_inputs"."stakeholder_support" is null
          and "score_inputs"."social_pressure_count" is null
